title: Structuring into a parametrized generic fails in modules with deferred annotations
title_original: Fix structuring of nested generics, add test
text_original: This mirrors #662 to allow nested generics for structuring nested generic classes. I encountered this issue when composing generic classes describing a REST API's JSON schema. It only seems to happen with string annotations. Without the patch, the included tests will show TypeErrors similar to: TypeError: ...Container[...Inner] is not a module, class, method, or function.
text_rewritten: We compose generic models to describe the shape of a REST API's JSON, and every module defers its annotations. Structuring an incoming payload into a parametrized generic dies with `TypeError: ...Frame[...Coordinate] is not a module, class, method, or function.` It happens whether the parameter is filled by a builtin or by another model, and it happens again one level deeper when a generic is nested inside a generic. Non-generic models in the same module structure fine. The annotation resolution step appears to be handed the parametrized form rather than the class it came from.

acceptance_hint: Structuring a payload into a parametrized generic works under deferred annotations - single- and multi-parameter, filled by builtins or by other models, and nested one generic inside another - while non-generic models are unaffected.
